description: Editorially selected historical AI policy and governance milestones. Not a comprehensive or live event feed. Coordinates identify an event venue, a city or an institution (as indicated by locationType); not necessarily where a legal measure takes effect.

events.title: India AI Impact Summit opens in New Delhi
events.subtitle: Global AI policy, industry and research gathering
events.summary: India hosted the AI Impact Summit at Bharat Mandapam, bringing government, research and industry participants together to discuss how AI can support public services and development.
events.imageCredit: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, India · GODL-India

events.title: AI Action Summit convenes in Paris
events.subtitle: International discussions on AI innovation and governance
events.summary: The AI Action Summit at the Grand Palais brought together heads of state, technology and civil-society representatives for discussions on AI investment, innovation, work and international cooperation.

events.title: AI and human rights treaty opens for signature
events.subtitle: Council of Europe Convention No. 225
events.summary: The Council of Europe opened its Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence, Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law for signature during the ministers' meeting in Vilnius.

events.title: European Parliament adopts its AI Act position
events.subtitle: A landmark legislative vote
events.summary: The European Parliament adopted its first-reading position on the Artificial Intelligence Act by 523 votes to 46, with 49 abstentions. The map shows its Strasbourg seat, where the plenary vote took place.

events.title: UN General Assembly adopts first standalone AI resolution
events.subtitle: Global cooperation on safe and trustworthy AI
events.summary: The UN General Assembly adopted Resolution A/RES/78/265 without a vote, calling for safe, secure and trustworthy AI that contributes to sustainable development.

events.title: US senators publish a bipartisan AI policy roadmap
events.subtitle: Proposals for future federal legislative work
events.summary: The US Senate's Bipartisan AI Working Group released a roadmap for potential legislation covering innovation, safety and governance. It is a set of policy recommendations, not an enacted federal AI law.

events.title: Bletchley Declaration establishes a shared AI safety agenda
events.subtitle: The first global AI Safety Summit
events.summary: Governments attending the UK AI Safety Summit at Bletchley Park agreed to cooperate on understanding and managing risks from frontier AI systems.

events.title: G7 launches the Hiroshima AI Process
events.subtitle: International work on generative AI governance
events.summary: G7 leaders at the Hiroshima Summit called for discussions on governance of generative AI. The Hiroshima AI Process subsequently led to international guiding principles and a voluntary code of conduct.
